game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Obsidian Quarry Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before smoke serpents spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: In Obsidian Quarry, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before smoke serpents spring the trap. Each round, a new fire gems challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of fire gems by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 36 seconds.
